name: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
headline: Bedrock AgentCore Gateway does OBO token exchange natively
lede: An agent can call the ServiceNow REST API as the calling user through native on-behalf-of token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID, without an interceptor Lambda or custom code.

effects.effect: agents act with real user permissions
less custom auth glue to audit

possibilities.title: Security audit findings can open ServiceNow tickets owned by the engineer who ran them
possibilities.connection: The Cloudflare audit skill produces machine-readable findings, and AgentCore Gateway now lets an agent call ServiceNow as the calling user with no custom token code.
